+### DRN-10.09 — CH1–CH5 and DIFF 1–5, from the deck
+
+**Statement.** Five challenges × five difficulties, the deck's challengeSpec verbatim: quota 4+CH×2+DIFF doors in play, window scaled by rate max(10, 56−CH×6−DIFF×4), concurrent doors 1→3, moving from CH3, NET at CH5. Chosen from two dropdowns in the top bar, never a hidden selector. At CH5 NET a red box must come from a second person; self-approval is refused CH5_NO_APPROVE and recorded as a HOLD. TG is not resurrected.
+

+
+### DRN-06.02 — The AsM Cup as a regression fixture
+
+**Statement.** ASM_CUP_99.json and ASM_ROSTER.csv are read-only by contract: their bytes are pinned by sha256 and a gate refuses if either moves. The published baseline — seed 2525, 6v6 BLU 3–1, 3v3 BLU 5–0, pairs 1–3 RED and 4–6 BLU at every level — is recomputed from the fixture's numbers, not restated. A new run writes a sidecar beside the fixture, never at it. The fixture's declared revision (0.039) is reported and flagged, not gated.
+

+
+### DRN-09.04 — The second person, over the link
+
+**Statement.** The targeteer's amber mark goes out on the gimbal word; the pilot's device shows it with an APPROVE button; the approval crosses the link as its own message, authored by seat, applied once by sequence on the device that holds the mark, in the sender's name — so the box reads two-person. A seat cannot approve its own mark through the link: its echo is dropped and the holder refuses a sender equal to the designator.
